context: A ward officer explains the benefit to a resident
purpose: Advise a citizen; teach 世帯/所得/適用/原則/制限/福祉/財源/協議/当事者/支持

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うちの世帯も対象になりますか？
lines.style: hopeful resident asking a practical question

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ご家庭の所得によって変わります。
lines.en: It depends on your household income.
lines.style: measured official giving a careful answer

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 所得が多いと適用外なんですね。
lines.en: So with higher income it doesn’t apply.
lines.style: understanding resident confirming the rule, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい、原則そういう制限があります。
lines.en: Yes, in principle there’s such a limit.
lines.style: polite official stating policy plainly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 福祉のお金って、財源は税金ですか？
lines.en: Is the welfare money funded by taxes?
lines.style: curious resident asking where money comes from

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ええ、使い道は議会で協議されています。
lines.en: Yes, its use is deliberated in the assembly.
lines.style: informative official explaining oversight, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 当事者として、ちゃんと支持したいです。
lines.en: As one affected, I want to support it properly.
lines.style: earnest resident expressing civic intent, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ご理解ありがとうございます。
lines.style: courteous official closing the exchange warmly
